title: Classes, constructors, properties and init blocks

videos.script: Until now a study session was a pair: a course, and a number. And it dot second said nothing about what the number meant. {{class}} This lesson gives the planner classes of its own. One line declares a course with a name and a weekly goal, and the compiler writes the fields, the getters and the constructor. {{props}} Then properties, which are not fields. They are functions that look like fields, and that is why a setter can refuse a negative goal without any caller changing. {{init}} Init blocks, and the order an object is built in, which is the order of the file, with one trap. {{secondary}} Secondary constructors, and why a default argument or a function usually does the job better. {{visibility}} Visibility, so a class can keep its own promises. {{late}} And lateinit, for the value that arrives a moment after the object does.
